cellMapDesigner.title: Cell Map Designer
cellMapDesigner.description: Cell Map Designer is an online tool that allows the graphic representation of cell towers and related coverage areas together with points of interest.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph1: It allows you to insert, modify and delete cell towers whose position is known. It has a ruler tool to measure distances.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph2: The tool allows importing multiple cell towers by uploading CSV files, and importing and exporting cells and points of interest via GeoJSON files.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph3: It also supports exporting KML files and importing KMZ overlays for compatibility with Google Earth.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph4: You can customize point of interest (PoI) icons thanks to the TomSelect library and manage icons directly from the sidebar, which is now resizable.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph5: You can show/hide cells and overlays, manage multiple overlays simultaneously and view a PoI table with automatic polygonal area calculation.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph6: The layout is fully responsive and numerous icons and a custom logo have been added.
cellMapDesigner.paragraph7: Among recent improvements: multiple overlay import, PoI table fix, image management optimization, and improved buttons.

seo.title: About - Alex Cortinovis
seo.description: Alex Cortinovis: digital forensics and data recovery since 2016 at a forensic computer engineering firm in Brescia, Italy. Teaching, background, certifications and open source tools.

about.jobTitle: Digital Forensics and Data Recovery Expert
about.title: About

intro.p1Before: I have been working in digital forensics and data recovery since 2016 at the
intro.p1After: of Michele Vitiello in Brescia, Italy. Every year around 300 devices — smartphones, computers, storage media and cloud accounts — cross my desk to be acquired and analysed, along with some thirty damaged media to recover data from.
intro.p2: Working on both fronts means I can also follow cases where the evidence sits on compromised media: from chip-off on NAND memory in a clean room to the technical report.

items.title: Forensic analysis
items.text: Acquisition and analysis of mobile devices, computers and cloud sources. Mostly civil cases (Business Email Compromise, log analysis, unfair competition, employment disputes) and criminal cases with a technical component. I work as an assistant to the technical expert, and since 2025 I co-sign the reports.

items.title: Call records and cell sites
items.text: I am the firm's lead for call detail record and cell coverage analysis, using SecurCube PhoneLog and {{cellMapDesigner}}, the mapping software I built for the job.

items.title: Data recovery
items.text: Hard disks, flash, SD and microSD with logical, physical or electronic damage; NAND chip-off, FTL reconstruction, PC-3000 Express and PC-3000 Flash.

items.title: Audio forensics
items.text: Restoration and enhancement of recordings, transcription, speaker comparison and identification.

items.title: Cyber security
items.text: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, incident response, analysis of malware, spyware and MITM attacks.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.text: I have been teaching digital forensics since 2017: courses for private clients and law enforcement at the firm and, since 2026, the CIFI (IISFA) certification prep course for Slash School — 40 hours over 20 lessons, which I designed from scratch.
